entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • LSP file-based app discovery follows directory symlinks with no loop check (unbounded CPU and memory) #86090
  • Syntax node actions for partial constructors are not called for the defining part #86086

Closed

  • Formatter inserts space in shebang ("#!" -> "# !") when indenting with tabs #85890
  • IDE0330 is not reported when type contains a multi-variable field declaration #86076
  • Nullable analysis around union construction ignores the fact that params array is never null #86055
    18.13

PullRequests

Created

  • Don't follow directory symlinks in file-based app discovery #86091
    Community, VSCode
  • Reuse MEF host wrappers within existing test scopes #86089
    VSCode
  • add WellKnownDiagnosticTags.RequiresUnconditionalSuppressMessageAttribute #86088
    Community, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • don't crash removing an unused variable assigned under an if without braces #86087
    Community, VSCode

Merged

  • Publish VSIX references before generating file manifests #86092
    Next
  • keep #! together when formatting a file based app with tabs #86085
    Community, VSCode, Next
  • Update FBA sources. Add --sdk-branch script param. #86080
    VSCode, Next
  • Fix IDE0330 not reported when type contains multi-declarator fields #86077
    Community, VSCode, Next
  • Set union values state as not-null when constructor invocation uses expanded form #86063
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions, Next

Updated

  • [release/insiders] Fix analyzer collision in bootstrap leg (backport #85870) #85987
    VSCode
  • Reduce accessibility for synthesized static local functions #86044
    Community
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3107710 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Keep tuple element names when nullable analysis re-infers a call with a tuple literal argument #85976
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Enforce BOM configuration in CI #85810
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Migrate C# and Visual Basic options to Unified Settings #86026
    VSCode
  • Implement OnDemand Project Loading #85805
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Split local and Helix test runners #85859
  • Compiler caching: add a simpler way to opt in #86078
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Caching Compiler
  • Improve diagnostics when a type is closed before its members #86034
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
  • Delay check for an ability to convert a Union case type to object #86079
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Restore metadata and analyzer references for cached projects #86049
    VSCode
